rulebook: OKDHS Licensing Requirements for Child Care Programs, Pub. 14-05 (effective 11/1/2025)

items.requirement: Documentation of annual parent conferences offered must be maintained.
items.quote: Documentation is maintained, per OAC 340:110-3-281.2(c)

items.requirement: Program policies must be provided to parents upon enrollment and when revisions are made.
items.quote: are provided to: (A) parents upon enrollment and when revisions are made

items.requirement: The parent handbook must include a brief program description.
items.quote: at least, include items (A) through (L), unless a statement is included addressing non-applicable items:

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state the ages of children accepted.
items.quote: (A) brief program description; (B) ages of children accepted;

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state days and hours of operation, including days closed such as holidays.
items.quote: days and hours of operation including days closed, such as holidays

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state the compliance file location.
items.quote: (C) days and hours of operation including days closed, such as holidays; (D) compliance file location;

items.requirement: The parent handbook must include relevant emergency plans and procedures information for parents.
items.quote: relevant emergency plans and procedures information for parents

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state health inclusion, separation, and exclusion criteria, including head lice and other infestations.
items.quote: health inclusion, separation, and exclusion criteria, including head lice and other infestations

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state whether the program administers medication and under what conditions.
items.quote: whether the program administers medication and under what conditions

items.requirement: The parent handbook must describe behavior management and discipline methods.
items.quote: (G) whether the program administers medication and under what conditions; (H) behavior management and discipline methods;

items.requirement: The parent handbook must include an expulsion policy.
items.quote: (H) behavior management and discipline methods; (I) expulsion policy;

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse and neglect.
items.quote: mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse and neglect

items.requirement: The parent handbook must include an infant safe sleep environment description.
items.quote: (J) mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse and neglect; (K) infant safe sleep environment description;

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for gaining building access when the entrance is secured.
items.quote: gaining building access when the entrance is secured

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for receiving and releasing children, including caller identification for authorized pickup.
items.quote: receiving and releasing children, including methods for caller identification authorizing child pick-up

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for notifying parents when a child does not arrive as required.
items.quote: notifying parents when a child does not arrive as required

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for monitoring children's health as required.
items.quote: monitoring children's health as required

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for notifying parents of communicable disease exposure while maintaining confidentiality.
items.quote: notifying parents of communicable disease exposure, while maintaining confidentiality of the ill child or personnel

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for notifying parents of infestation exposure while maintaining confidentiality.
items.quote: notifying of infestation exposure, while maintaining confidentiality of the infected child or personnel

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for handling illnesses, injuries, and poison exposures, including when children are off-site.
items.quote: handling illnesses, injuries, and poison exposures, including when children are off-site

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for storing, administering, returning, and medication disposal.
items.quote: storing, administering, returning, and medication disposal

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for storing, using, returning, and medical waste disposal such as syringes, needles, and lancets.
items.quote: storing, using, returning, and medical waste disposal, such as syringes, needles, and lancets

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for using sun safety methods such as sunscreen and protecting children from over-exposure to the sun.
items.quote: using sun safety methods, such as sunscreen and protecting children from over-exposure to the sun

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for using insect repellent.
items.quote: (x) using sun safety methods, such as sunscreen and protecting children from over-exposure to the sun; (xi) using insect repellent;

items.requirement: When program liability insurance is not maintained or the program reports being self-insured, the insurance exception notification must be posted at the main entrance.
items.quote: program liability insurance is maintained, unless an exception, per the Oklahoma Child Care Facilities Licensing Act, Section 404.3 of Title 10 of the Oklahoma Statutes (10 O.S. § 404.3), is posted

items.requirement: Vehicle insurance must be maintained and documentation available.
items.quote: Vehicle insurance is maintained, per OAC 340:110-3-281.2(c) and (d)

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for transporting children.
items.quote: (xii) managing children's personal belongings; (xiii) transporting children; (xiv) notifying parents of field trips;

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for notifying parents of field trips.
items.quote: (xiii) transporting children; (xiv) notifying parents of field trips;

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for receiving children arriving late for field trips when the group has left the facility.
items.quote: receiving children arriving late for field trips when the group has left the facility

items.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for providing meals and snacks, including field trips.
items.quote: providing meals and snacks, including field trips

items.requirement: When the program has two or more personnel, personnel policies must be provided to personnel upon employment and when revisions are made.
items.quote: are provided to personnel upon employment and when revisions are made

items.requirement: When the program uses volunteers, volunteer policies must be provided to volunteers upon starting service and when revisions are made.
items.quote: are provided to volunteers upon starting service and when revisions are made

items.requirement: Emergency plans must be individualized, followed, and maintained, and include procedures for specified situations and child considerations.
items.quote: The program is required to have emergency plans that are: (A) individualized to the program and operating hours

items.requirement: First aid kits must contain specified supplies and be accessible to personnel and inaccessible to children.
items.quote: First aid kits are accessible to personnel at all times and inaccessible to children

items.requirement: Monthly fire and tornado drills must be conducted and documented.
items.quote: Monthly. Monthly drills include: (I) fire drills conducted by evacuating and meeting at pre-determined locations; and (II) tornado drills conducted by sheltering in pre-determined on-site locations

items.requirement: Suspected child abuse or neglect must be reported promptly to the OKDHS Child Abuse and Neglect Hotline.
items.quote: OKDHS Child Abuse and Neglect Hotline at 1-800-522-3511

items.requirement: The owner, responsible entity, or director must notify Licensing by the next business day of specified changes, incidents, injuries, deaths, and diseases.
items.quote: The owner, responsible entity, or director notifies Licensing by the next Oklahoma Human Services (OKDHS) business day of

items.requirement: Licensing must be notified at least 30 calendar days prior to anticipated closings, location changes, facility changes, business entity changes, name changes, or licensed capacity changes.
items.quote: The owner, responsible entity, or director notifies Licensing at least 30-calendar days prior to

items.requirement: Parents must be notified immediately of specified urgent situations such as a child not arriving, injury needing physician evaluation, poison exposure, or animal bite breaking skin.
items.quote: The program notifies parents immediately of: (A) a child not arriving at the facility on his or her own as scheduled

items.requirement: Parents must be promptly notified when a child is separated due to illness or infestation or has a suspected allergic reaction.
items.quote: The program promptly notifies parents when a child: (A) is separated from the group due to an illness or infestation

items.requirement: The program must promptly or by the next health department business day notify the local or state health department of specified diseases and outbreaks.
items.quote: The program promptly notifies the local or OSDH of a known case in individuals associated with the program

items.requirement: Upon receiving notice of a substantiated heinous and shocking abuse finding, the facility must notify parents using an OKDHS-provided form within 72 hours by certified mail.
items.quote: immediately attempted but not later than 72 hours of notice receipt from OKDHS; and (ii) provided by certified mail

items.requirement: Parents must be notified upon child pickup of daily happenings, changes in physical or emotional state, minor injuries, illness symptoms, exposures, medication administration, animal bites, and implemented emergency plans.
items.quote: The program notifies parents upon child pick up of: (A) daily happenings

items.requirement: Parents must be notified prior to each field trip of the date, time, and location.
items.quote: Prior to each field trip, the program notifies parents of the date, time, and location

items.requirement: Parents must be notified upon enrollment and prior to changes in the presence of animals, tobacco or simulated tobacco use, and weapons.
items.quote: Upon enrollment and prior to changes. The program notifies parents upon enrollment and prior to a change in the presence of: (A) animals; (B) tobacco or simulated tobacco use; and (C) weapons

items.requirement: The Notice to Parents publication must be posted at the main entrance.
items.quote: Oklahoma Human Services (OKDHS) Publication No. 14-01, Notice to Parents, is posted

items.requirement: Evacuation routes must be posted on each floor.
items.quote: Evacuation routes. A floor plan with primary and secondary evacuation routes from each area of the building is posted on each floor

items.requirement: The weekly menu, including dates and substitutions, must be posted in a prominent location and in the kitchen.
items.quote: Weekly menu. The menu, including dates and substitutions, is posted

items.requirement: The director's full name and at least one additional personnel responsible in the director's absence must be posted.
items.quote: The program posts the director's full name and at least one additional personnel responsible for the program in the director's absence

items.requirement: A notice of the Child Abuse and Neglect Hotline number and requirement to report suspected abuse or neglect must be posted.
items.quote: A notice of the Child Abuse and Neglect Hotline number and requirement to report suspected abuse or neglect is posted

items.requirement: The OKDHS permit or license must be posted in a prominent location for parents and the public.
items.quote: Permit or license. The OKDHS permit or license is posted

items.requirement: The OKDHS Star certificate must be posted.
items.quote: Star certificate. OKDHS Star certificate is posted

items.requirement: A tobacco-free environment notice must be posted at the main entrance and not combined with other posted items.
items.quote: Tobacco-free environment notice. The notice is not combined with other posted items

items.requirement: Children's food and life-threatening allergies must be posted, including full name and location of life-threatening condition medications.
items.quote: The program posts children's food and life-threatening allergies, including the child's full name, and location of any life-threatening condition medications

items.requirement: Applicable ratios and group sizes must be posted in classrooms.
items.quote: Ratios and group sizes. The applicable program-type ratios and group sizes, per OAC 340 Appendix GG - Ratios and Group Sizes are posted

items.requirement: A daily classroom schedule with required content must be posted.
items.quote: Daily classroom schedule. The program posts a schedule with the required content, per OAC 340:110-3-289(b)

items.requirement: Weekly lesson plans with dates and required content must be posted.
items.quote: Weekly lesson plans. The program posts lesson plans with the dates and required content, per OAC 340:110-3-289(d)

items.requirement: A microwave warning must be posted on all microwaves.
items.quote: OKDHS Publication No. 97-27, Microwave Warning, is posted

items.requirement: Hand washing procedures must be posted near sinks.
items.quote: The program posts OKDHS Publication No. 14-02 – Hand Washing Procedures Using Paper Towels or OKDHS Publication No. 14-03 – Hand Washing Procedures Using Mechanical Hand Dryers

items.requirement: The licensing requirements publication must be accessible in a prominent location for parents and the public.
items.quote: Oklahoma Department of Human Services (DHS) Publication No. 14-05, Licensing Requirements for Child Care Programs, is accessible

items.requirement: A compliance file with specified monitoring, investigation, and waiver documents must be maintained together with most recent on top and child identifying information removed.
items.quote: The compliance file includes items within the last 120 calendar days, at a minimum

items.requirement: Transportation attendance must be immediately documented each time a child enters and exits the vehicle.
items.quote: Attendance is: (A) immediately documented each time each child enters and exits the vehicle

items.requirement: Before leaving the vehicle, the driver or last personnel must document completion of at least two methods of inspecting all areas for remaining children.
items.quote: the driver or last personnel in the vehicle documents completion of at least two methods of inspecting all areas of the vehicle for any remaining children

items.requirement: Child information must be completed by the parent prior to the first day of attendance and be paper only.
items.quote: completed by the parent prior to the child's first day of attendance; and (B) paper only

items.requirement: Daily records for infants and 1-year-olds must be available in the classroom and include prompt documentation of eating, diapering, and sleeping.
items.quote: Daily records for 1-year-olds and younger are available in the child's classroom and include prompt documentation of eating, diapering, and sleeping activities

items.requirement: Verbal authorizations for child pickup must be documented with date, time, validity period, and full names.
items.quote: personnel document the authorization, including the: (A) authorization date and time; (B) time period the authorization is valid

items.requirement: Signed and dated parent permission is required for specialized service professionals.
items.quote: Signed and dated parent permission is available

items.requirement: A food reward exception requires a behavior modification plan with director and parent signatures and date signed.
items.quote: A behavior modification plan is available and includes content, per OAC 340:110-3-288(d), director and parent signatures, and the date signed

items.requirement: An immunization record or exemption must be obtained prior to the first day of attendance and updated when additional vaccines are received.
items.quote: An immunization record or exemption is obtained prior to the first day of attendance and is updated when the child receives additional vaccines

items.requirement: Signed parent permission for each medication must be obtained prior to administration.
items.quote: Signed parent permission for each medication is obtained, prior to administration

items.requirement: Each dose administered, excluding diaper cream, must be immediately documented.
items.quote: Each dose administered, excluding diaper cream is immediately documented

items.requirement: An injury or poison exposure report must be completed for each injury or poison exposure occurring while in care.
items.quote: An OKDHS or program form containing similar information is completed for each injury or poison exposure occurring while in care

items.requirement: Written statements from licensed physicians, signed parent permissions, or both are required when infant safe sleep exceptions apply.
items.quote: Written statements from licensed physicians, signed parent permissions, or both are available when required

items.requirement: Signed parent permission for transportation must be obtained prior to transportation and include vehicle, driver, and pickup/drop-off plan information.
items.quote: Signed parent permission: (A) is obtained prior to transportation

items.requirement: Signed parent permission for field trips must be obtained prior to the field trip and maintained for at least 12 months.
items.quote: Signed parent permission is obtained prior to the field trip, and documentation is maintained for at least 12 months from the trip

items.requirement: A higher risk activity plan must be provided to parents and signed parent permission obtained prior to the activity.
items.quote: A plan is provided to parents, and signed parent permission is obtained prior to the activity

items.requirement: A signed and dated parent statement regarding the water depth a child may swim in must be obtained prior to water activity.
items.quote: A signed and dated parent statement regarding the water depth the child may swim in is obtained prior to the water activity

items.requirement: Written statements from licensed physicians are required for special diets for infants when required.
items.quote: Written statements from licensed physicians are maintained when required

items.requirement: The number of children in care at one time, on- or off-site, must not exceed licensed capacity.
items.quote: The maximum number of children in care at one time, whether on- or off-site, does not exceed the licensed capacity specified on the current permit or license

items.requirement: Required staff-to-child ratios must be maintained at all times.
items.quote: The program is required to maintain ratios at all times

items.requirement: Supervision must be maintained at all times.
items.quote: The program is required to maintain supervision at all times

items.requirement: Children must never be left unattended in vehicles.
items.quote: Children are never left unattended in vehicles

items.requirement: Personnel are prohibited from physical discipline such as shaking, hitting, spanking, pinching, and similar actions.
items.quote: actions that could cause pain, such as shaking, hitting, striking with an object, spanking, swatting, thumping, pinching

items.requirement: Personnel are prohibited from psychological or emotional discipline such as humiliating, rejecting, or neglecting a child.
items.quote: humiliating, rejecting, or neglecting a child

items.requirement: Time-out is limited to one minute or less for each year of age and only for children 2 years or older.
items.quote: Personnel use this method only with children 2 years of age and older

items.requirement: Food must not be used to obtain or reward desired behaviors, except under an approved exception plan.
items.quote: Food is not used to obtain or reward desired behaviors

items.requirement: Parents must be notified of animals' presence upon enrollment and prior to changes.
items.quote: Parents are notified of animals' presence, per Oklahoma Administrative Code (OAC) 340:110-3-280(d)

items.requirement: Common hosts of rabies ineligible for USDA-approved rabies vaccinations and wild or dangerous animals are prohibited on-site.
items.quote: Prohibited animals on-site, unless the requirements specifically state otherwise, include: (A) common hosts of rabies ineligible for United States Department of Agriculture (USDA)-approved rabies vaccinations; and (B) wild or dangerous animals

items.requirement: Parent permission is required for medication administration, specialized service professionals, transportation, field trips, higher risk activities, and swaddling.
items.quote: Parent permission is maintained, per Oklahoma Administrative Code (OAC) 340:110-3-281.4(b), and required for: (A) medication administration; (B) services provided by a specialized service professional; (C) transportation; (D) field trips; (E) higher risk activities; and (F) swaddling

items.requirement: Parents of enrolled children must be allowed reasonable access to facility areas used by children.
items.quote: Parents of enrolled children are allowed reasonable access to facility areas used by children

items.requirement: The program must provide at least four family engagement options from the listed choices.
items.quote: The program provides at least four of the options in (1) through (6) of this subsection

items.requirement: Tobacco use is prohibited in the presence and sight of children during hours of operation, including off-site, and in facility buildings and outdoor play areas at all times.
items.quote: Tobacco use is prohibited in: (i) the presence and sight of children during the hours of operation, including off-site; (ii) facility buildings and outdoor play areas, at all times

items.requirement: Medications may only be administered by designated personnel and only to the child whose full name is on the container label.
items.quote: Medications are only administered: (A) by the designated personnel per OAC 340:110-3-281.2(c), with the exception of diaper cream; and (B) to the child whose full name is on the container label

items.requirement: Medications must be inaccessible to children.
items.quote: Medications are inaccessible to children per OAC 340:110-3-303(g)

items.requirement: Medications must be maintained in the original container, labeled with the child's full name, and stored according to the label.
items.quote: Medications are: (1) maintained in the original container; (2) labeled with the child's full name; (3) stored according to the container label, including temperature

items.requirement: Soft products such as quilts, comforters, pillows, stuffed toys, and bumper pads are prohibited in infant rest equipment.
items.quote: Soft products, such as quilts, comforters, sheepskins, pillows, stuffed toys, and bumper pads are prohibited inside and on the side of infant rest equipment

items.requirement: Infants must be placed on their back for sleeping unless a medical reason is documented.
items.quote: Infants are placed on their back for sleeping, unless there is a medical reason an infant should not sleep in this position

items.requirement: Children 1 year through 4 years must be provided a rest time.
items.quote: Children are provided a rest time

items.requirement: Diapers must be checked hourly and when a child exhibits behavior suggesting a wet or soiled diaper.
items.quote: checked hourly and when a child exhibits behavior suggesting a wet or soiled diaper

items.requirement: Diaper changing procedures must be posted in diaper changing areas.
items.quote: per Oklahoma Administrative Code (OAC) 340 Appendix KK – Diaper Changing Procedures. The procedures are posted

items.requirement: Meals and snacks must meet current CACFP guidelines, except for infants.
items.quote: Meals and snacks are required to meet the current Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) guidelines

items.requirement: Safe drinking water must be freely available to children at all times.
items.quote: Safe drinking water is freely available to children at all times

items.requirement: The program must not provide drinks sweetened artificially or with sugar, including soda.
items.quote: The program does not provide drinks sweetened artificially or with sugar, including soda

items.requirement: The program must not provide caffeinated drinks, including soda and energy drinks.
items.quote: The program does not provide caffeinated drinks, including soda and energy drinks

items.requirement: Infants must not be fed honey or peanut butter.
items.quote: infants are not fed honey or peanut butter

items.requirement: Bottles must not be propped by any means at any time.
items.quote: Bottles are not propped by any means at any time

items.requirement: Outdoor play areas must be enclosed by a building or fence meeting height and condition requirements.
items.quote: Outdoor play areas are enclosed by a building or fence

items.requirement: Use zones around play equipment must meet clearance requirements and not overlap, with stated exceptions.
items.quote: Use zones are defined, per OAC 340:110-3-275

items.requirement: Impact-absorbing materials are required in use zones for climbers, swings, slides, and revolving equipment.
items.quote: Impact-absorbing materials: (A) are required in use zones for: (i) climbers; (ii) swings; (iii) slides; and (iv) revolving equipment

items.requirement: Vehicles transporting children must have a first aid kit.
items.quote: Vehicles have a first aid kit, per OAC 340:110-3-279(d)

items.requirement: Children must remain properly secured in a child passenger restraint system or individual seat belt unless the vehicle is exempt.
items.quote: Children remain properly secured in child passenger restraint system, such as a car or booster seat or an individual seat belt complying with applicable state laws

items.requirement: Child care centers must provide meals and snacks for 2-year-olds through 5-year-olds who are not attending or have not completed kindergarten.
items.quote: Programs provide meals and snacks per OAC 340:110-3-298(c) for 2-year-olds through 5-year-olds who are not attending or have not completed kindergarten

items.requirement: Single-age groups must follow the listed ratios and maximum group sizes by age.
items.quote: Infants 1:4 8 1-year-olds 1:6 12 2-year-olds 1:8 16 3-year-olds 1:12 24

items.requirement: Children with fever of 100 degrees axillary or 101 degrees oral with another sign or symptom must be excluded from programs serving only well children.
items.quote: Fever, defined as axillary (armpit) temperature of 100 degrees or higher, or oral temperature of 101 degrees or higher, with another sign or symptom of illness

dropped_unverified.requirement: The parent handbook must state procedures for managing children's personal belongings.
dropped_unverified.quote: (xi) using insect repellent; (xii) managing children's personal belongings;

dropped_unverified.requirement: Mixed-age groups must follow the listed ratios and limits on younger children per teaching personnel.
dropped_unverified.quote: Infants and older 1:8 No more than two under 2 years of age per teaching personnel

dropped_unverified.requirement: Hands must be washed when visibly dirty and after specified activities.
dropped_unverified.quote: Visibly Dirty Hands When hands are visibly dirty Hand Wash*
